photos.file_title: File:Aerial view of Apple Park dllu.jpg
photos.author: Daniel L. Lu (user:dllu)
photos.description: Aerial view of Apple Park, the corporate headquarters of Apple Inc., located in Cupertino, California. The roof is covered in solar panels with an output of 17 MWp, making it one of the biggest solar roofs in the world. Photo taken from a Cessna 172M.
